_readme: Foreigner checklist per venue slug. Only facts already read on the venue's OFFICIAL page (the venue page's source + check date). Venue email replies are NOT used here. Missing key = Not confirmed. Keys: tattoo, card (foreign card payment), english (English booking/staff), dropin (open to visitors without a room/membership).

grand-josun-busan.tattoo: Tattoos 15cm or larger must be covered with a patch. Not coverable = no entry.

commodore-hotel-busan.dropin: Yes, walk-in rate listed. Adult men only.

fraser-place-central-seoul.restriction: All in-house hotel guests only (non-guests cannot enter).
fraser-place-central-seoul.booking: In-house guest access during stay (room booking required).
fraser-place-central-seoul.full_price: Included/guest facility; no separate sauna fee listed on the official page.
fraser-place-central-seoul.closures: Closed 1st Wednesday of every month (subject to change on holidays).
fraser-place-central-seoul.age_tattoo_attire: Children entering the opposite-gender sauna must be under age 3 · Tattoo rule not stated.

grand-josun-jeju.dropin: No. Hotel guests only (included during stay).

crossfit-grove-gunja.dropin: Yes. Drop-in request form on its site.

signiel-seoul.public_access: No. Fitness club members and in-house hotel guests only.
signiel-seoul.restriction: Strictly limited to Signiel Seoul hotel guests and fitness members (non-guests not admitted).
signiel-seoul.booking: In-house guest or member entry at 85F desk.
signiel-seoul.english: Official English hotel facility page available.
signiel-seoul.full_price: Hotel guest sauna admission ₩44,000 per entry (membership fee not shown on page).
signiel-seoul.closures: Closed last Wednesday of every month.
signiel-seoul.age_tattoo_attire: Age 16+ only · Visitors with tattoos may be restricted from entry (official page).
signiel-seoul.dropin: No. Members and hotel guests only.

signiel-busan.dropin: No. Members and hotel guests only.

orakai-cheonggyesan.public_access: Yes. Explicitly open to non-guests as well as hotel guests.
orakai-cheonggyesan.restriction: Open to general public and hotel guests (hotel guests receive a discounted rate).
orakai-cheonggyesan.booking: Walk-in entry; body scrub (세신) is on-site sign-up only.
orakai-cheonggyesan.kr_phone: Not required for walk-in ticket purchase at the B1 front desk.
orakai-cheonggyesan.full_price: Adult non-guest ₩24,000 · Hotel guest ₩18,000 · Child (ages 8–13) ₩14,000 (official hotel guide, checked 2026-10-18).
orakai-cheonggyesan.scrub_fee: Available on site (walk-in sign-up only, closed Mondays; exact fee not listed on official page).
orakai-cheonggyesan.closures: Monthly maintenance closures in 2026: Oct 12, Nov 9, Dec 14 (body scrub closed every Monday).
orakai-cheonggyesan.age_tattoo_attire: Under age 8 not admitted · Ages 8–16 require an accompanying guardian · Tattoo rule not stated.
orakai-cheonggyesan.dropin: Yes. Open to everyone, room or not (adult ₩24,000).

heosimcheong-busan.dropin: Yes. Open to general public (adult weekday ₩15,000 / weekend ₩18,000).

sisu-house.public_access: Yes. Open to the general public by advance reservation (private 1-person rooms).
sisu-house.restriction: Strictly 1 person per room (no couples or 2-person shared entry; confirmed by venue 2026-10-18).
sisu-house.booking: 100% advance booking required via Naver Booking; international visitors can request a booking link via official Instagram DM (@sisuhouse.official), KakaoTalk channel, or email.
sisu-house.kr_phone: Naver Booking requires a verified account; visitors without a Korean number can book via Instagram DM, KakaoTalk channel, or email.
sisu-house.english: Official website headings in English; foreign booking inquiry supported via Instagram DM / email (spoken staff fluency not stated).
sisu-house.full_price: Sisu Spa Basic ₩79,000 · Sisu Spa Deep ₩89,000 · Sisu Recovery ₩109,000 (venue reply 2026-10-18).
sisu-house.scrub_fee: Not applicable (Finnish dry sauna & ritual touch program; no traditional 세신).
sisu-house.age_tattoo_attire: Private 1-person room (tattoos are not exposed to other guests); age limit not stated on official page.
sisu-house.tattoo: Private 1-person room (no shared bath exposure; official page states no tattoo ban).

solo-sauna-repo-noryangjin.public_access: Yes. Open to the general public by advance reservation (private Finnish sauna rooms).
solo-sauna-repo-noryangjin.restriction: Women's and men's solo rooms (1 person); family room allows up to 2 people.
solo-sauna-repo-noryangjin.booking: 100% advance reservation required (walk-ins without a booking not accepted).
solo-sauna-repo-noryangjin.full_price: Solo room (1 person) 60 min ₩45,000~ / 90 min ₩55,000~ · Family room (2 people) 100 min ₩120,000~ (official operator profile, checked 2026-10-22).
solo-sauna-repo-noryangjin.closures: Closed 2nd and 4th Monday of every month.
solo-sauna-repo-noryangjin.age_tattoo_attire: Private room format; specific age or attire rules not stated on official profile.
solo-sauna-repo-noryangjin.tattoo: Private room format (no shared bath exposure; no tattoo restriction stated).
solo-sauna-repo-noryangjin.dropin: Yes, by advance reservation (private solo/family rooms).

novotel-ambassador-seoul-gangnam.restriction: Not confirmed whether non-guests without membership or a room may enter.
novotel-ambassador-seoul-gangnam.full_price: Sauna admission fee not listed on official page.
novotel-ambassador-seoul-gangnam.scrub_fee: Body clean (세신) ₩35,000 extra (official KR & EN pages).
novotel-ambassador-seoul-gangnam.age_tattoo_attire: Ages 15 and under restricted (16+ only) · No swimwear allowed in sauna or baths · No entry after alcohol or with skin diseases.

banyan-tree-club-seoul.public_access: No. Club members and in-house hotel guests only.
banyan-tree-club-seoul.restriction: Banyan Tree Club members and hotel guests (guest rate listed at 50% off regular price).
banyan-tree-club-seoul.booking: Hotel room or club membership required; body scrub/shine last registration 19:20.
banyan-tree-club-seoul.full_price: Hotel guest rate ₩35,000 (stated as 50% off regular price; membership fee not listed).
banyan-tree-club-seoul.scrub_fee: Body scrub (세신) 09:00–19:00 & shoe shine until 20:00 (last registration 19:20; separate fee not listed on page).
banyan-tree-club-seoul.age_tattoo_attire: Tattoos 15 × 15 cm or larger permitted only when covered with a tattoo patch or personal rash guard · Bathrobe and towels provided · No smoking.
banyan-tree-club-seoul.tattoo: Tattoos 15 × 15 cm or larger permitted only when covered with a patch or personal rash guard.
banyan-tree-club-seoul.dropin: No. Club members and hotel guests only.

park-hyatt-seoul.restriction: Hotel guests and Park Club members (non-guest walk-in eligibility not stated on official page).
park-hyatt-seoul.closures: 2026 scheduled maintenance: Sauna & Spa closed Nov 12; Pool & Fitness closed Nov 19.
park-hyatt-seoul.age_tattoo_attire: Age 16+ only · Tattoo and attire rules not stated on official page.

grand-hyatt-seoul.restriction: Not confirmed on official page (inquiry sent 2026-10-18; awaiting official hotel reply).
grand-hyatt-seoul.english: Official hotel & spa pages available in English and Korean.
grand-hyatt-seoul.full_price: Not confirmed on official page (third-party figures excluded).
grand-hyatt-seoul.last_entry: Not confirmed (The Spa hours 09:30–21:30; standalone sauna hours not stated).

ambassador-seoul-pullman.public_access: No (members, member-accompanied guests, and hotel guests).
ambassador-seoul-pullman.restriction: Wellness Center members (free), member-accompanied guests (₩33,000), and hotel guests (₩33,000).
ambassador-seoul-pullman.booking: In-house guest or member/member-guest check-in at B2 Wellness Center.
ambassador-seoul-pullman.full_price: Hotel guests ₩33,000 · Member guests ₩33,000 · Members free (English guide also lists Adults 16+ ₩33,000 / Children 7 and under ₩22,000).
ambassador-seoul-pullman.scrub_fee: Body clean (세신): Member ₩35,000 / Non-member ₩40,000 · Body oil massage: Member ₩100,000 / Non-member ₩110,000.
ambassador-seoul-pullman.age_tattoo_attire: No swimsuits allowed in sauna or baths · No entry after drinking alcohol · Skin disease / public hygiene restrictions apply (English guide notes Adult rate applies age 16+).
ambassador-seoul-pullman.dropin: No. Hotel guests, members, and member-accompanied guests only.

termeden-icheon.dropin: Yes. Day-pass tickets open to general public (adult full-day ₩49,000; bathhouse-only ₩18,000).

spa-haesurang-busan.dropin: Yes. Open to general public (adult sauna weekday ₩15,000 / weekend ₩18,000).

riverside-hotel-medi-spa.dropin: Yes. Walk-in day ₩28,000 / night ₩35,000. Men only.

seian-yeonnam-seoul.english: Official Instagram (@seian_spa) posts in English and Japanese; bookings by Instagram DM (spoken staff fluency not stated). Checked 2026-10-25.
